assignments.reason: Charity on Shabbat is a specific instance of the charity-sun nature. The Torah identifies it as 'בְּחִינַת אוֹר הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כְּאוֹר שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים' — an aspect of the sun's light like the light of the seven days. Its essential nature is the luminous, empowering, charitable radiance that defines Package 2. Although it is performed on Shabbat (Package 1's domain), the act itself IS charity/sun, not truth/support.

assignments.node_id: הנותן כח לבחינת שלש רגלין הנ"ל
assignments.reason: This node describes the empowerment of the three legs (שלש רגלין). The three legs — two natural legs plus the רגל שלישי (third leg = אמת = סעד) — are the walking apparatus restored by Shabbat. The essential nature of this concept is the stabilized, supported walking in God's ways, which is the core identity of Package 1 (Shabbat-Truth-Support-ThirdLeg). The 'giving of power' to the legs is the EFFECT in the eitza chain, but the legs themselves belong essentially to Package 1.

assignments.node_id: צדקה שעושה בשבת, הינו שנותן לאדם על שבת, או שמאכסן עני על שלחנו
assignments.reason: This is the practical elaboration of Shabbat charity — giving a person provisions for Shabbat or hosting the poor at one's table. Its essential nature is the act of giving/charity, the solar-luminous empowering force. The Torah treats this as the concrete form of the sun-charity that corresponds to the future sun (שמש העתידה להתחדש כאור שבעת הימים). Belongs to Package 2 by essential charitable-solar nature.

assignments.node_id: לברך את השלש רגלים הנ"ל, ולתן כח בהם, כדי שיוכלו לילך היטב
assignments.reason: This node describes blessing the three legs and empowering them to walk well. Its essential nature is the legs/walking domain — the restored capacity to walk in God's ways that Shabbat enables. The שלש רגלים (three legs) are the structural core of Package 1: two legs weakened by the Chitzonim during weekdays, plus the third leg (אמת/סעד). The blessing and empowerment of these legs is essentially about the walking-on-Shabbat reality.

assignments.node_id: לתן כח בהם שיוכלו לילך כראוי
assignments.reason: This is a condensed restatement of the same concept: giving power to the legs to walk properly. Its essential nature is the empowered walking capacity — the legs functioning as they should when Shabbat liberates them from the Chitzonim's grip. This walking-empowerment reality belongs to Package 1 (Shabbat-Truth), which is the domain of restored holy walking.
